title: Oscar Wilde, The Picture of Dorian Gray recast
author: Salon
note: This whole-book remake includes murder, a blackmail death, and self-destruction via the portrait. Period-true to Wilde’s ending, written without gore spectacle. Warn the room before you Host it; offer a midpoint pause if needed.
